class.name: Tractable
class.brief_description: Class for objects that can be attracted by the UFO.
class.description: This Class should be the parent of the object's [RigidBody3D]. This will (once setup) will allow the object to be attracted by the UFO's tractor beam. The [Rigidbody3D] should be on collision layer 3 (Tractables) to be hit by the tracotr beam, and layer 1 (All) if it should collide with other objects. The Class requires a reference to the object's [RigidBody3D] and should be setup with a [param Points] to reward the player for sucessfully picking it up.

members.member: The number of points to award the player when the item is successfully collected.
A reference to the [RigidBody3D] of the object. Stored internally as an ObjectID.

return.description: Used when the object is collected. Deletes the object and returns the number of points to be collected.

Used to add a force to the object's [Rigidbody3D] using a [Vector3] [code]global_position[/code] representing the global position of the force and a [Vector3] [code]direction[/code] representing the direction of actio nof the force.

Used to add a force to the object's [Rigidbody3D] using a [Vector3] [code]local_position[/code] representing the local position of the force and a [Vector3] [code]direction[/code] representing the direction of actio nof the force.
